family.description: This domain is found at the N-terminal of Nuclear speckle splicing regulatory protein 1 (NRP1, also known as Nuclear speckle-related protein 70 and Coiled-coil domain-containing protein 55) and contains a coiled-coil domain that plays a critical role in NRP1 alternative splicing activity and self-oligomerization. NRP1 is a RNA-binding protein that mediates pre-mRNA alternative splicing regulation [[cite:PUB00093376],[cite:PUB00093375]].
family.name: Nuclear speckle splicing regulatory protein 1, N-terminal
